idle.action: grounded side-view karate fighting stance with guarded hands, subtle breathing and stable feet

walk-forward.action: grounded side-view karate advance with alternating contacts, passing poses and guarded upper body

walk-back.action: grounded side-view guarded karate retreat with distinct backward footwork and weight transfer

crouch.action: descent from karate guard into a low guarded crouch with feet locked to the baseline

jump.action: vertical karate jump with launch, rising pose, peak, descent and compressed landing

light-strike.action: fast lead-hand karate jab with immediate launch, contact, follow-through and guard recovery

heavy-strike.action: committed rooted karate reverse punch with load, hip drive, contact, follow-through and recovery

special.action: original full-body karate kata strike with load, contact, follow-through and recovery

throw.action: close-range karate foot sweep without an opponent sprite, with entry, hook, sweep, release and recovery

guard.action: karate forearm guard with stable stance, compact impact recoil and return to guard

hitstun.action: torso impact reaction from the front with recoil, overshoot and partial balance recovery

knockdown.action: forceful backward knockdown with balance loss, rotation, ground contact and settled pose

ko.action: heavy knockout collapse with stagger, knee failure, full fall, ground impact and final still pose

win.action: restrained karate victory sequence with breath release, belt adjustment and severe final stance
